message:
Partial refunds now come out right. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` treated `percent` as a fraction, even though it's a 0–100 value, so every refund was 100 times too large. It now divides by 100 before rounding.

The full suite passes (20 of 20), including the two partial-refund tests. The change is one line and stays inside `src/payments`.
